userRequest: Choose a durable distributed job queue for media processing and scheduled retries.
successConditions: Multiple workers can claim jobs without duplicate concurrent processing.
Failed jobs retry with backoff and survive application restarts.

identityFacts: Job payloads carry tenant-scoped media identifiers but no credentials.
dataFacts: Media metadata is stored in PostgreSQL and ephemeral queue state may use the existing durable Redis cluster.
operationalFacts: The team already operates persistent Redis and long-running worker containers.

hardConstraints.statement: Queue state must be shared across workers and survive process restarts.
The candidate must provide automatic retries with configurable backoff.

preferences.statement: Prefer reuse of the existing Redis service and client expertise.

reasonCodes.description: The case requires built-in retry and backoff behavior.
The case requires persistent queue state shared by multiple workers.
The candidate can use the existing PostgreSQL service.
The candidate directly uses the repository's existing Redis service.

unknowns.description: Capacity impact on the shared Redis cluster has not been load-tested.
